title: Identification of Npas4 as a biomarker for CICI by transcriptomics combined with bioinformatics and machine learning approaches.
authors: He, Zhenyu; Ma, Huanhuan; Zhang, Yu; Chen, Liping; Pang, Yueling; Ding, Xiaoshan; Wang, Yanan; Liu, Yongqi; Li, Ling; Li, Jiawei
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组与机器学习筛选化疗认知障碍相关生物标志物Npas4，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，仅属纯表达分析与生物标志物筛选，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chemotherapy is one of the most successful strategies for treating cancer. Unfortunately, up to 70 % of cancer survivors develop cognitive impairment during or after chemotherapy, which severely affects their quality of life. We first established a mouse model of CICI and combined bioinformatics, machine learning, and transcriptome sequencing to screen diagnostic genes associated with CICI. Relevant DEGs were screened by differential analysis, and potential biological functions of DEGs were explored by GO and KEGG analysis. WGCNA analysis was then used to find the most relevant modules for CICI. The diagnostic gene Npas4 was screened by combining the three machine learning methods; its diagnostic value was proved by ROC analysis, GSEA analyzed its potential biological function, and then we preliminarily explored the chemicals associated with Npas4. Our study found that Npas4 can be used as an early diagnostic gene for CICI, which provides a theoretical basis for further research.
abstract_zh: 化疗是治疗癌症最成功的策略之一。不幸的是，高达70%的癌症幸存者在化疗期间或之后会出现认知障碍，严重影响其生活质量。我们首先建立了CICI小鼠模型，并结合生物信息学、机器学习和转录组测序来筛选与CICI相关的诊断基因。通过差异分析筛选出相关DEGs，并通过GO和KEGG分析探索DEGs的潜在生物学功能。随后使用WGCNA分析找到与CICI最相关的模块。通过结合三种机器学习方法筛选出诊断基因Npas4；通过ROC分析证明其诊断价值，GSEA分析其潜在生物学功能，然后我们初步探索了与Npas4相关的化学物质。我们的研究发现Npas4可作为CICI的早期诊断基因，这为进一步研究提供了理论基础。
